drhp.business: Rajputana Stainless manufactures long and flat stainless-steel products - billets, forging ingots, rolled black bar, rolled bright bar, flat & patti, wire rods and ancillary products - in over 80 grades under the 'RSL' brand. sk.drivers: Infrastructure development and National Infrastructure Pipeline|'Make in India' and manufacturing push|Construction, real estate and capital goods demand|Automotive and white-goods sector recovery|Rising steel intensity and urbanization|Seamless pipe demand from oil & gas, petrochemicals, renewables
sk.overview: India is the world's second-largest crude steel producer and second-largest stainless-steel consumer/third-largest producer, with estimated installed SS capacity of 6.6-6.8 Mn tons. Stainless steel is a high-alloy, corrosion-resistant value-added steel (>10.5% chromium) used across railways, process industries, kitchenware, automotive, construction and infrastructure. Long and flat steel demand is closely tied to overall economic, industrial and consumer activity; the sector is raw-material (SS scrap, nickel, chromium) and energy intensive and prices are volatile.
sk.schemes: National Steel Policy 2017|Make in India|National Infrastructure Pipeline|Import tariffs on stainless steel|Union Budget 2025-26 infrastructure and manufacturing incentives
sk.structure: Steel splits into long (bars, rods, wire, billets) and flat (HR/CR, strips) products; stainless steel is high-alloy steel with 200/300/400 series (Cr-Ni 300-series ~55% of SS output). Production via BF-BOF (conventional) or EAF/induction (scrap-based) routes. India second-largest crude steel …
